## Soft Metadata

> [!WARNING]
> **Tier 2 (community estimate)** — Soft Metadata below adapted from Springer publisher pages and domain knowledge of child clinical-psychology editorial culture. **Note**: Journal renamed to *Research on Child and Adolescent Psychopathology* in 2021 (anti-stigma editorial alignment with broader field shift). Submission practitioners are invited to upgrade individual claims to Tier 1 via `/ja-validate`. See [SEED_DATA_QUALITY.md](../../../../SEED_DATA_QUALITY.md) for the Skeleton → Tier 2 → Tier 1 lifecycle.

> **The core value of this entry.** OpenAlex cannot fill any of these — they require lived experience and community knowledge. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../../../CONTRIBUTING.md) for guidance.

### Epistemological & Political Leanings

| Dimension | Assessment |
|-----------|------------|
| **Cross-cultural friendliness** | High |
| **Non-Western epistemology openness** | Medium |
| **Diversity topic receptiveness** | High — child mental health diversity, cultural psychopathology |
| **Dominant theoretical tradition** | Child / adolescent clinical psychology — psychopathology mechanism, developmental psychopathology, family-systems clinical research |

### Framing Requirements

- **Mandatory framing?** Yes (strong)
- **If yes, what kind?** Manuscripts must demonstrate **child / adolescent psychopathology contribution** with empirical mechanism or treatment focus. Anti-stigma framing aligns with 2021 rename.
- **Consequences of ignoring it**: Manuscripts redirected to JCPP, Dev Psych, or JCCP if scope mismatch.

## Strategic Notes

### Hard Blockers

- Manuscripts without child / adolescent psychopathology focus
- AI use without disclosure per Springer policy
- Stigmatizing framing of child mental illness (post-2021 rename signal)

### Soft Tax

Low for child clinical-psychology empirical authors. Springer Nature Choice OA available; preprint policy applies.

### Best Suited For

- Child / adolescent psychopathology mechanism research
- ADHD, conduct, anxiety, depression empirical work
- Trauma / abuse mechanism studies
- Family / parenting clinical research
- Longitudinal developmental psychopathology
- Child intervention RCTs

### Not Recommended For

- Adult psychopathology (consider J Psychopathology and Clinical Science)
- Pure developmental work without clinical focus (consider Dev Psych)
- Pure autoethnography or first-person work
- Treatment effectiveness only without mechanism

### Rejection Fallback Chain

| Rank | Journal | Why this fallback works |
|------|---------|------------------------|
| 1 | [Journal of Child Psychology and Psychiatry](./journal-of-child-psychology-and-psychiatry.md) | ACAMH / Wiley peer; child/adolescent psychiatry |
| 2 | [Developmental Psychology](./developmental-psychology.md) | If developmental-process focus; APA |
| 3 | [Journal of Consulting and Clinical Psychology](./journal-of-consulting-and-clinical-psychology.md) | If treatment-focused; APA |

**Reverse direction** *(optional)*: If your paper was rejected from JCPP as "too child-focused" or from Dev Psych as "too clinical," this Springer venue specializes in the child-psychopathology mechanism niche.
